arm-A.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-A.summary: Morpheus confirms Trinity's hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake. She runs the building's exterior to the street — hall, fire escape, roof, across the rooftops, and down through a window into a back stairwell — while the Agents pursue and match her. She reaches a ringing booth on the street and is gone before a garbage truck crushes it, so the Agents are left with wreckage and no body, but with the crew's next target named as Neo.
arm-A.action: After Morpheus confirms the hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake, Trinity bursts into the hall into Agent Brown and his police unit and flees she plummets through the shattered glass and onto the fire escape. Finding Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, she climbs to the roof and runs the rooftops, clearing a 40-foot gap the cops cannot follow while Agent Brown duplicates the leap with the same unnatural grace. She launches from the roof's edge toward a lit window, dives, crashes through glass into a back stairwell, and — finding only wind where she expects Brown — gets to her feet despite her injuries. On the street she races a U-turning garbage truck to a ringing phone booth, answers it, and is gone before the truck pulverizes the booth; the Agents inspect the wreckage with no body, but leave with the next target named as Neo.

arm-B.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-B.summary: Morpheus tells Trinity her hardline is cut and Agents are in the building, so she abandons the hotel line and is redirected to a phone at Wells and Lake. She breaks past Agent Brown in the hall, climbs the fire escape when Smith blocks the alley, and crosses the rooftops with leaps the cops cannot match but that Brown duplicates. She dives through a window into a back stairwell, crashes down injured, finds no pursuer behind her, and reaches a street phone booth where she answers the ringing phone a moment before a garbage truck destroys the booth, which carries her out. The Agents never catch her, but the informant's tip gives them the crew's next target, and they set a machine search on the name Neo.
arm-B.action: Enables Trinity's extraction while she is still a second ahead of the garbage truck, but hands the Agents the name of their next target, Neo; it costs Trinity a clean escape and leaves her battered, and it converts a failed capture into an active machine search.

arm-A.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-A.summary: Morpheus confirms Trinity's hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake. She runs the building's exterior to the street — hall, fire escape, roof, across the rooftops, and down through a window into a back stairwell — while the Agents pursue and match her. She reaches a ringing booth on the street and is gone before a garbage truck crushes it, so the Agents are left with wreckage and no body, but with the crew's next target named as Neo.
arm-A.action: After Morpheus confirms the hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake, Trinity bursts into the hall into Agent Brown and his police unit and flees she plummets through the shattered glass and onto the fire escape. Finding Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, she climbs to the roof and runs the rooftops, clearing a 40-foot gap the cops cannot follow while Agent Brown duplicates the leap with the same unnatural grace. She launches from the roof's edge toward a lit window, dives, crashes through glass into a back stairwell, and — finding only wind where she expects Brown — gets to her feet despite her injuries. On the street she races a U-turning garbage truck to a ringing phone booth, answers it, and is gone before the truck pulverizes the booth; the Agents inspect the wreckage with no body, but leave with the next target named as Neo.

arm-B.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-B.summary: Morpheus tells Trinity her hardline is cut and Agents are in the building, so she abandons the hotel line and is redirected to a phone at Wells and Lake. She breaks past Agent Brown in the hall, climbs the fire escape when Smith blocks the alley, and crosses the rooftops with leaps the cops cannot match but that Brown duplicates. She dives through a window into a back stairwell, crashes down injured, finds no pursuer behind her, and reaches a street phone booth where she answers the ringing phone a moment before a garbage truck destroys the booth, which carries her out. The Agents never catch her, but the informant's tip gives them the crew's next target, and they set a machine search on the name Neo.
arm-B.action: Enables Trinity's extraction while she is still a second ahead of the garbage truck, but hands the Agents the name of their next target, Neo; it costs Trinity a clean escape and leaves her battered, and it converts a failed capture into an active machine search.

arm-A.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
arm-A.summary: A phone reaches Neo's cubicle and Morpheus, on the line, warns that forces are closing in and will not say what they intend. Neo sees Agent Smith leading cops onto the floor and a female employee pointing out his cubicle, and he follows Morpheus's instructions out of the row and into an empty office. Morpheus directs him out to a ledge from which he can reach the roof; Neo commits, but his nerve breaks when the wind blasts him and the phone falls from his grip just as a cop opens the door, and he climbs back inside into the hands of the waiting cop. He is seized, handcuffed, and forced into a dark sedan in the Agents' custody. Trinity, watching from her motorcycle, sees him taken and knows the extraction has failed.
arm-A.action: The event folds a raid, a guided escape, and a failed leap into one motion. Neo is converted from a recipient of messages into a fugitive and then into a prisoner: guided out of the cubicle, out to the window ledge, and back inside into Agent Smith's custody. Morpheus's remote guidance gets him out of the row but cannot steady his body at the ledge, and the dropped phone severs his only link to that guidance at the moment he most needs it. The one exit he could not bring himself to take is the only one that would have kept him free.

state_triples.reading: Neo is being tested at every level at once — his body betrays him, his self-image as an insignificant man who did nothing collides with a pursuit that treats him as the most wanted person in the building, and his terror of the ledge blinds him to the fact that capture is the worse fate. He follows Morpheus because the alternative is to stay and find out what 'they' will do, but the moment the choice becomes physical and solitary, the part of him that has always believed he is nobody wins, and he climbs back toward the danger he thinks is survivable. arm-B.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
arm-B.summary: A cell phone delivered to Neo's cubicle connects him to Morpheus, who warns that the Agents are closing in and guides him through the office as a search closes in. Neo slips past the search into an empty office, where Morpheus directs him to open a window and cross a scaffold to the roof as the only exit. Neo refuses the climb, then attempts it, but the wind knocks him off balance, he drops the phone, and his nerve breaks. He climbs back inside just as a cop reaches the room, and is taken: the Agents lead him handcuffed out of the skyscraper and force him into a dark sedan, while Trinity witnesses the capture in her motorcycle's rearview mirror.
arm-B.action: The event opens with Neo at his cubicle receiving a phone that rings with Morpheus on the line, warning that the Agents are coming and that he does not know what they will do. Neo glimpses Agent Smith, Agent Brown and [...] cops onto the floor, and a female employee points out his cubicle. Following Morpheus's commands, Neo lunges into an empty cubicle, hides while the Agents search his own, then rolls out, freezes behind a cop, and sneaks across the row into an empty office. There Morpheus directs him to open a window and cross a scaffold to the roof; Neo refuses, then relents and climbs onto the ledge, but a blast of wind knocks him off balance, he drops the phone, and he retreats inside just as a cop opens the door. The Agents then lead a handcuffed Neo out of the skyscraper and force him into a dark sedan, while Trinity watches the capture in her motorcycle's rearview mirror and reacts with dismay.
